description: This file is a source JavaScript file implementing the DataTables plugin for jQuery. It includes definitions for initializing, configuring, manipulating, and rendering HTML tables with features like sorting, filtering, pagination, and Ajax data loading.

classes.name: DataTable
classes.description: Main class constructor for initializing a DataTable instance with configuration options and methods for table manipulation.

methods.name: _fnAddColumn( oSettings, nTh )
methods.description: Adds a new column to the table with default or specified options.

methods.name: _fnColumnOptions
methods.description: Applies configuration options to a specific table column, including types, visibility, and sorting classes.

methods.name: _fnAdjustColumnSizing( oSettings )
methods.description: Adjusts column widths dynamically based on new data, typically called before table redraw.

methods.name: _fnVisibleToColumnIndex
methods.description: Converts a visible column index to the corresponding data array index, considering hidden columns.

methods.name: _fnColumnIndexToVisible
methods.description: Converts a data array index to the current visible column index.

methods.name: _fnVisbleColumns
methods.description: Returns the count of visible columns in the table.

methods.name: _fnGetColumns
methods.description: Retrieves an array of column indexes matching a specified property such as 'bVisible' or 'bSearchable'.

methods.name: _fnDetectType
methods.description: Detects the data type of a value (e.g., string, number, date) for sorting purposes.

methods.name: _fnReOrderIndex
methods.description: Reorders a list of column indexes based on a comma-separated list of column names.

methods.name: _fnColumnOrdering
methods.description: Returns the current column order as a comma-separated string of sName properties.

methods.name: _fnApplyColumnDefs( oSettings, aoColDefs, aoCols, fn )
methods.description: Applies column definitions and static columns to the table, executing a callback for each.

methods.name: _fnAddData( oSettings, aDataSupplied )
methods.description: Adds data as a new row to the table, creating DOM nodes if necessary.

methods.name: _fnGatherData
methods.description: Reads data from the DOM into the internal data cache, used during initialization.

methods.name: _fnNodeToDataIndex
methods.description: Converts a TR node to its index in the internal data array.

methods.name: _fnNodeToColumnIndex
methods.description: Finds the column index corresponding to a TD node within a specific row.

methods.name: _fnGetRowData
methods.description: Extracts data for a specific row as an array, based on the internal cache.

methods.name: _fnGetCellData
methods.description: Retrieves data for a specific cell from the internal cache, considering data mapping.

methods.name: _fnSetCellData
methods.description: Updates the internal cache for a specific cell with new data.

methods.name: _fnGetObjectDataFn
methods.description: Returns a function to get nested object data from a data source string.

methods.name: _fnSetObjectDataFn
methods.description: Returns a function to set nested object data on a data source string.

methods.name: _fnGetDataMaster
methods.description: Returns the entire master data array from the internal cache.

methods.name: _fnClearTable
methods.description: Removes all data and resets the internal data structures.

methods.name: _fnDeleteIndex
methods.description: Removes an index from an array and adjusts subsequent indices.

methods.name: _fnRender
methods.description: Calls a user-defined cell rendering function with the appropriate context and data.

methods.name: _fnCreateTr
methods.description: Creates a table row (TR) element for a given data index, applying rendering and classes.

methods.name: _fnBuildHead
methods.description: Generates or updates the table header HTML structure based on column configs.

methods.name: _fnDrawHead
methods.description: Constructs the header (or footer) row layout based on column visibility and custom layout.

methods.name: _fnDraw
methods.description: Redraws the entire table, including processing callbacks, filtering, and rendering rows.

methods.name: _fnReDraw
methods.description: Triggers a redraw, optionally invoking sorting or filtering first.

methods.name: _fnAddOptionsHtml( oSettings )
methods.description: Constructs the table's HTML controls (pagination, search box, length menu, etc.) according to configuration.

methods.name: _fnDetectHeader
methods.description: Analyzes the DOM header/footer nodes to produce a layout grid of cell positions.

methods.name: _fnGetUniqueThs
methods.description: Returns a unique list of header TH elements, considering merged cells.

methods.name: _fnAjaxUpdate( oSettings )
methods.description: Performs an Ajax request to update table data from the server.

methods.name: _fnAjaxParameters( oSettings )
methods.description: Builds an object containing parameters for server-side processing requests.

methods.name: _fnServerParams
methods.description: Allows plugins or custom code to add parameters to Ajax requests.

methods.name: _fnAjaxUpdateDraw( oSettings, json )
methods.description: Handles updating table data with a server response JSON object, possibly reordering data.

methods.name: _fnFeatureHtmlFilter
methods.description: Creates the HTML element for the global filter input.

methods.name: _fnFilterComplete
methods.description: Performs filtering operations on the table data, considering both global and column filters.

methods.name: _fnFilterComplete
methods.description: Performs the final filtering on the table, combining global filter, column filters, and custom filters, then triggers redraw and events.

methods.name: _fnFilterCustom
methods.description: Applies custom filtering functions to the data set based on user-defined criteria.

methods.name: _fnFilterColumn
methods.description: Filters the data table on a per-column basis using a search string and options like regex, smart filtering, and case insensitivity.

methods.name: _fnFilter
methods.description: Filters the table data based on user input, updating the display array, and triggers redraw.

methods.name: _fnBuildSearchArray
methods.description: Creates an array for quick searching, based on current display indices or master data.

methods.name: _fnBuildSearchRow
methods.description: Creates a searchable string from a data row, decoding HTML entities and removing newlines.

methods.name: _fnFilterCreateSearch
methods.description: Constructs a RegExp object suitable for filtering based on provided search string, regex flag, smart filter, and case insensitivity.

methods.name: _fnDataToSearch
methods.description: Converts raw data into a string suitable for searching, applying functions for specific types or stripping HTML.

methods.name: _fnEscapeRegex
methods.description: Escapes special regex characters in a string to safely use in a regex search.

methods.name: _fnFeatureHtmlInfo
methods.description: Builds the HTML node for displaying table info (like record counts).

methods.name: _fnUpdateInfo
methods.description: Updates the informational display of the table with current record counts and macros.

methods.name: _fnInfoMacros
methods.description: Replaces macros in info strings with current table statistics.

methods.name: _fnInitialise
methods.description: Initializes the DataTable, building headers, footers, controls, and handling initial data load.

methods.name: _fnInitComplete
methods.description: Callback called after initial table setup, indicating completion.

methods.name: _fnLanguageCompat
methods.description: Ensures backward compatibility for language options by copying shared values.

methods.name: _fnFeatureHtmlLength
methods.description: Creates the HTML control for changing the page length.

methods.name: _fnCalculateEnd
methods.description: Calculates the display end index based on current start index and page length.

methods.name: _fnFeatureHtmlPaginate
methods.description: Builds the pagination UI component and initializes page navigation.

methods.name: _fnPageChange
methods.description: Handles changing pages in the DataTable, updating the display index accordingly.

methods.name: _fnFeatureHtmlProcessing
methods.description: Creates the processing indicator element.

methods.name: _fnProcessingDisplay
methods.description: Shows or hides the processing indicator during long operations.

methods.name: _fnFeatureHtmlTable
methods.description: Constructs the table container HTML when scrolling features are enabled, including headers, body, footer, and scroll synchronization.

methods.name: _fnScrollDraw
methods.description: Updates the table layout when scrolling is enabled, recalculating sizes, widths, and positioning.

methods.name: _fnApplyToChildren
methods.description: Applies a function to child nodes of a list of DOM elements, with optional second node list.

methods.name: _fnConvertToWidth
methods.description: Converts CSS width units to pixels, useful for sizing calculations.

methods.name: _fnCalculateColumnWidths
methods.description: Calculates optimal column widths based on content and user specifications, adjusting the table layout accordingly.

methods.name: _fnScrollingWidthAdjust
methods.description: Adjusts the table width to account for scrollbar presence when scrolling.

methods.name: _fnGetWidestNode
methods.description: Finds the widest DOM node within a column to determine necessary width.

methods.name: _fnGetMaxLenString
methods.description: Finds the row index with the maximum string length in a column for width calculation.

methods.name: _fnStringToCss
methods.description: Ensures CSS width units are in pixels or leaves them as is if already valid.

methods.name: _fnScrollBarWidth
methods.description: Computes the width of the browser's scrollbar in pixels.

methods.name: _fnSort
methods.description: Performs the sorting operation on the table based on current sorting configuration, updating classes and triggering events.
